summary: The diff implements most of the required features: REQ-20 (timeframe selector with 1m/15m/1h options and default 1m), REQ-21 (EMA9/EMA21 for 1m, EMA20/EMA50/EMA200 for 15m/1h), REQ-22 (MACD hidden for 1m with note), REQ-23 (ATR optional for 1m), REQ-24 (rule engine with timeframe-specific logic), and REQ-25 (timeframe badge in results card). All core requirements appear implemented. However, due to file truncation, some acceptance criteria details cannot be fully verified.
